about_short_description.short_description: A service for finding and purchasing shares in a second home. Seqoon makes co-ownership of vacation homes accessible and effortless.

product.name: Fractional Vacation Home Co-Ownership
product.description: A service that enables individuals to purchase fractional shares of vacation homes through an LLC structure, providing property ownership and scheduled use at a portion of the full purchase cost.

product.name: Vacation Home Listings Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace for browsing and purchasing shares in selected vacation homes, with property details, locations, layouts, sizes, share prices, and availability status.

product.name: Vacation Property Management
product.description: A property management service covering the ongoing operation and upkeep of co-owned vacation homes, including furnishings, utilities, maintenance, and coordination with co-owners.

identifier.value: Owner Stay Booking and Scheduling Platform

product.name: Owner Stay Booking and Scheduling Platform
product.description: A website and app-based system that lets co-owners view availability, schedule allocated nights, book stays up to 24 months ahead, and obtain additional days from other owners.

identifier.value: Co-Ownership Share Resale and Property Liquidity Service

product.name: Co-Ownership Share Resale and Property Liquidity Service
product.description: A service that helps property owners sell a portion of an existing vacation home while retaining a remaining share, and supports co-owners in re-listing or selling their ownership shares.
